source: C.Lee copy rules and Product Designer empty value rules, Oct 23 2026

em-dash.message: Em dash in copy. Rewrite with a comma, period, colon or parentheses.

en-dash.message: En dash in copy. Use 'to' for ranges or rewrite.

hyphen-dash.message: Spaced hyphen ' - ' used as a dash in copy. Rewrite.

dash-placeholder.message: Standalone dash as an empty value. Use 'Not set' (fillable field), 'No data yet' plus a next step link (empty metric) or 0 (real zero). See lib/empty-values.ts.

edi-sftp.message: EDI or SFTP named in copy. These are not mentioned at all, roadmap included.

epcis-unlabeled.message: EPCIS mentioned without 'Preview' in the same string or line. Intake and export both count.

invented-entity.message: Invented supplier, facility, lot or number. Real data only: render real data or an empty state.

live-claim.message: A non-live capability is labeled Live, Implemented, GA or Available.

pilot-status.message: Pilot is not an approved badge or status label.

sample-demo.message: Sample, demo, simulated or synthetic wording in copy.

empty-render.message: Blank fallback rendered in JSX. Use an explicit empty state.
